summary: The dashboard is live at https://antipo.watch with a valid certificate, through Cloudflare and a Worker that relays to the Fly.io app; www and http redirect to the apex; the fly.dev address is unchanged. Three Cloudflare defaults that altered the page (analytics beacon, browser check, e-mail rewriting) are off. 14 real-browser tests pass against the domain. The procedure and its pitfalls are in the Second Brain for a Loop0 expert. Not run: the owner's look on a phone.
delivered: Cloudflare zone antipo.watch: proxied AAAA 100:: records for the apex and www, Worker routes on both, SSL Full (strict), Always Use HTTPS, TLS 1.2 minimum, Browser Integrity Check and e-mail obfuscation off.

Worker antipo-watch (deploy/cloudflare/worker.js): 301 to https://antipo.watch for any other name or http; relays method, path, query and body to the fly.dev address; rewrites fly.dev redirects; adds no-transform; edge-caches versioned /static/ files.
INFRASTRUCTURE.md: a Domain section with a diagram, settings, Worker deployment, token permissions, rollback and the cost of the hop; D-034; README, STATUS, SECURITY, CHANGELOG.
Second Brain: the owner's directive, the Fly.io TLS pitfall, and the full procedure with its pitfalls, written for a future DNS expert.
decisions: Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-16: use antipo.watch; record the expertise in the Second Brain; an Account API token held by Agent Manager.
Proposed (D-034): proxied DNS and a relaying Worker instead of a Fly.io certificate, which needs Fly.io access; antipo.watch is the main address and fly.dev stays; Full (strict), HTTPS only, TLS 1.2.
Found: Cloudflare's role Workers Editor alone was refused for publishing a Worker by API; Workers Scripts Edit (legacy) worked. It covers the whole account, so it is removed after deployment.

tests.command: DNS-over-HTTPS NS lookups at cloudflare-dns.com and dns.google

tests.notes: CN antipo.watch, SAN antipo.watch and *.antipo.watch, Let's Encrypt, valid to 2027-02-15.

tests.command: curl redirects for http://antipo.watch/, https://www.antipo.watch/x?y=1, http://www.antipo.watch/
tests.notes: 301 to https://antipo.watch with path and query kept (www tested with --resolve: the local resolver had cached the name as missing).
14 passed after the Cloudflare defaults were turned off; the first run failed on the injected analytics script (CSP) and a 403 from the browser check.

tests.command: E2E_BASE_URL=https://antipo.watch uv run pytest -m e2e -k loads_fast (repeated)
tests.notes: Borderline: passed 2 of 3 runs alone and in the full run; failures at 1.01 to 1.5 s against the 1 s limit. The relay adds about 0.45 s before the first byte.

tests.command: uv run pytest && uv run ruff check .
Real use: http://antipo.watch opened in Chromium at phone size
tests.notes: Lands on https://antipo.watch, same page; screenshot devlog/img/loop-005-phone.png.

remainingWork: Owner: remove Workers Scripts Edit and Workers Editor from the token.
Owner: open https://antipo.watch on a phone.
The load-time test is borderline through the relay: a Fly.io certificate for antipo.watch would remove the hop if Fly.io access becomes available.
